articleTitle: Impact of the Feed-Forward Compensation on the Synchronization Stability
abstract: With the power system migrating to higher renewable and higher power electronics, the power converter shall remain the grid connection during the fault occurrence for the sake of the power system stability. The synchronization instability is the main issue for the unstable operation of these grid-tied converter. The concept of the synchronization stability has been proposed to define the ability of the converter to hold on a stable operation after subjecting a large disturbance. From previous research, the current transients couples to the synchronization transients and thus worsens the stability. The feed-forward compensator in the current control can help fasten the current stabilization and decouple the converter transients from the grid, thus potentially could improve the synchronization stability. However, this aspect has not been investigated before. This paper analyses the impact of the feed-forward compensator on the synchronization stability. The simulation results in Matlab/Simulink indicate that the feed-forward compensator with a small time constant can improve the synchronization stability and in this situation, a 2nd-order converter model is effective to represent its transient response.

articleTitle: Multi-VSG inverter oower sharing MPC-VSG Control for islanded microgrid
abstract: Most of the microgrid inverters are based on PI-based voltage and current double-loop control structure to achieve control target, but the controller parameter setting is complicated and the dynamic response speed is slow. The paper adopt Predictive Models Control (MPC) replace traditional voltage and current double-loop and modulation to improve the dynamic response speed and parameters tuning. In order to maintain the damping character of microgrid and overcome droop control frequency change rate, this paper adopts the strategy of Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) in the power loop to make the power sharing evenly and keep the system inertia and stability. The simulation comparison verifies the proposed control strategy is effective and the faster response speed.

articleTitle: RISK ANALYSIS OF CYBER PHYSICAL DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM CONSIDERING CYBER ATTACKS ON V2G SYSTEM
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous promotion of smart grid construction and the implementation of energy conservation and emission reduction policies, electric vehicle, as a green travel tool, has been vigorously promoted by the government. Disorderly charging of large-scale electric vehicles will aggravate the peak valley difference of the power system, overload the branch power flow and over limit the voltage. Vehicle to grid (V2G) system based on price based demand response technology can charge and discharge orderly according to real time price set by distribution system operator. Aiming at V2G system, this paper proposes a cyberattack, in which attacker can tamper with the day-ahead real time price information, thus malicious manipulation electric vehicle charging or discharging behavior, and ultimately destroy the safe and reliable operation of the power grid. Finally, an IEEE 33 bus example is built to analyze the impact of the this cyberattack on distribution network, the results verify easibility of the proposed model and providing the future model bases for risk assessment of cyber physical distribution system.

articleTitle: Partition Control Method of Power Balance of Multi.Provincial Grid with High Penetration of Renewable Energy
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy in the power grid, coordinated operation of multi-provincial grid is an effective measure to improve the renewable energy accommodation capacity of power grid. It is difficult to guarantee that the active power of tie lines is equal to their dispatching plan by calculating the power flow distribution in the whole network. Therefore, a partition control method of power balance of multi.provincial grid with high penetration of renewable energy is proposed. Due to multiple load deviation adjustments and AC power flow calculation of each province, the active power of tie lines can be ensured to be equal to their dispatching plan. The proposed method is composed of two sectors: distribution method of load deviation of each province with a high proportion of renewable energy, in which the balanced relationship of power generation and consumption of each province is established; accurate estimation method of transmission loss of each province under the future operation mode based on prediction and correction, in which the calculation error of unbalance caused by the estimation error of transmission loss can be further reduced. A case study based on an actual multi.provincial grid demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Thinking on Promoting Coordinated and Orderly Development of New Energy and Energy Storage
abstract: With the accelerating development of clean energy transformation in China, the proportion of new energy will continue to increase, its characteristics of strong randomness, high volatility and poor anti disturbance ability will pose new challenges to the safe and reliable operation of power grid. The large-scale application of energy storage is one of the effective means to break through the bottleneck of new energy development. It has significant advantages in improving the flexibility of power system, promoting the consumption of new energy, and ensuring the security of power grid. It is of great significance to promote the transformation of China's energy structure and ensure the security of energy supply. This paper analyzes the demand of new energy development for peak load regulation of power grid, analyzes and considers the application prospect of energy storage and the current challenges, and puts forward some suggestions to promote the coordinated and orderly development of new energy and energy storage.

articleTitle: Analysis of Extreme Cold Weather Event in Texas of February 2021 and Suggestions for China
abstract: From February 13 to February 17, 2021, a state-wide blackout occurred in Texas, USA. During the extreme cold weather event, approximately 48.6% of generation was forced out at the highest point due to the impacts of various extreme weather conditions, which affected the normal electricity usage of at least 4 million residents. The accident report of the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) provided a preliminary analysis of the factors causing the power outage. Based on the public reports from the ERCOT or other related agencies, this paper reviews the large-area blackout in Texas from February 13th - 17th, 2021. Firstly, the process and timeline of the power outage event have been described. Then, the main reasons for the accident have been sorted out and summarized from the aspects of extreme cold weather, natural gas system, power generation plant, system flexibility, etc. Furthermore, combined with the current situation of China's power grid, the corresponding suggestions have been proposed for preventing such events.

articleTitle: INFLUENCE OF PLL ON BROADBAND OSCILLATION UNDER WEAK GRID
abstract: The integration of large-scale renewable energy into the weak power grid has aroused a series of broadband oscillation problems. Converter is an important link between renewable energy and power grid, in which phase locked loop (PLL) can track the phase angle and frequency of power grid. At present, the influence of PLL parameters on system stability is often studied. With the increase of PLL bandwidth, the frequency range of converter negative damping increases, and the system is prone to broadband oscillation. This paper further studies the influence of the coupling between PLL and the steady-state operation point. The converter admittance can be divided into two parts. One part is only related to the converter circuit and control, and the other affected by the interaction of PLL and the operation point. Then, the system stability is analysed according to the generalized Nyquist criterion (GNC), and the grid impedances and converter power levels required for the system stability are given. The research can provide reference for field test and operation.

articleTitle: A MULTI-AGENT MICROGRID ENERGY MANAGEMENT SOLUTION FOR AIR TRANSPORT ELECTRIFICATION
abstract: To achieve net-zero emissions in air transport industry with defined CO2 mitigation objectives in “Flightpath 2050”, electrically powered aircraft as part of electrified aviation become attractive technologies. In recent years, many electric aircraft prototypes for short-haul commuting air transport have been designed. Most of them are supposed to be deployed in the real airports by 2030 - 2035. However, the ground power systems and associated electric aircraft charging operation are also essential for realising electrified aviation. Moreover, various renewable generation technologies in terms of PVs and micro wind turbines, electric vehicles and energy storage systems are expected to be integrated into the airport to form a decarbonised microgrid energy system. Therefore, there is a challenge of designing airport microgrids associated with energy scheduling algorithms for electric aircraft charging as well as airport decarbonisation. To overcome this challenge, this paper proposes a multi-agent real-time microgrid energy scheduling solution for electrified air transport. The coordination algorithm between the electric aircraft charging system and the electric vehicles charging in the airport parking lot is developed to enhance the resilience and operational flexibility of the airport microgrid. The stochastic behaviours of the airport passengers and renewable power generation are integrated into the airport microgrid energy management solution. The study shows that the airport microgrid can achieve the resilience through the proposed energy management solution.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short-Term Wind Power Forecasting Based on Attention Mechanism
abstract: Ultra-short-term wind power forecasting can realize real-time situational awareness of wind power, improve the share of wind power in a grid and reduce grid instability. Existing models often show limited capability to extract key time-series features for forecasting. This paper proposes an ultra-short-term wind power forecasting (4 hour-ahead) model (Attention Model) based on an encoder-decoder structure with integrated attention mechanism. Multi-head self-attention is used in the encoder, and the decoder is built by a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) with improved Bahdanau attention. With the attention mechanism, Attention Model can automatically extract important sequential information from the time-series historical power data, and can be explainable to some extent. Compared with other state-of-the-art models, Attention Model demonstrates improved accuracy for the first forecasting step (15 minute-ahead) by 27%∼58%, by 1%∼12% for the last step (4 hour-ahead) and 4%∼20% for 4-hour average.

articleTitle: MULTI-OBJECTIVE OPTIMAL REACTIVE POWER DISPATCH FOR DISTRIBUTION NETWORK CONSIDERING PV GENERATION UNCERTAINTY
abstract: In recent years, as the installed capacity of distributed generation (DG) and the penetration level continue to increase, the uncertainties of the DGs like photovoltaic (PV) generation bring new problems and challenges to the reactive power and voltage control in distribution systems. In this paper, a multi-objective optimal reactive power (VAR) dispatch model for distribution network considering PV generation uncertainty is established, aiming at minimizing the active power loss and minimizing the voltage deviation. Regarding the uncertainty of PV power output, a truncated double Gaussian mixture model is applied to construct the probability density function of solar irradiance, and the copula theory is utilized to describe the PV power spatial dependence between multiple PV stations. In addition, a scenario analysis method with an improved K-means scenario reduction technique is applied to obtain the typical scenarios considering PV power spatial dependence. To solve the complicated optimization model, a multi-objective particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is applied to obtain the Pareto front, and the fuzzy set theory is employed to determine the compromise solutions. Finally, the corresponding simulations are performed on the IEEE 33-bus test system to demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed optimization model.

articleTitle: Interaction between PMSG and DFIG in a hybrid wind farm integrated through a VSC-HVDC
abstract: The electrical oscillations may occur in both the permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG)-based wind farm and double fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind farm. However, the interaction between them in a DFIG-PMSG hybrid wind farm still need to be investigated, especially when integrated through a voltage source converter based HVDC (VSC-HVDC) system. In this paper, the influence of PMSG on the sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) origins from DFIG with a VSC-HVDC is analysed based on the sequence impedance models. Similarly, the influence of DFIG on the medium-frequency oscillation (MFO) origins from PMSG with a VSC-HVDC is analysed as well. The analysis results show that both the two types of oscillations can be avoided according to the interaction between PMSG and DFIG with the appropriate parameters, which is meaningful for the actual project. Finally, the correctness of the analysis results is validated by time-domain simulation.

articleTitle: APPLICATION OF DEEP RESIDUAL NETWORK IN FAULT DIAGNOSIS OF PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULES
abstract: Fault diagnosis techniques can accurately determine the health condition of photovoltaic modules, as well as the specific fault type and level. Conventional machine learning diagnosis algorithms rely on expert knowledge and manual feature extraction to build feature engineering, which usually leads to limited performance. In addition, the existing fault diagnosis methods of photovoltaic modules have a limitation. They only take the influence of the area size of fault array into account when determining the fault level, and ignore the effect caused by the degree of fault factor itself. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method of photovoltaic modules based on deep residual network, which can automatically extract useful fault features. Raw current-voltage characteristic curves and ambient conditions are used as the input of the network. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed methodology, two datasets are obtained based on a laboratory experiment platform and the corresponding simulation model respectively. Furthermore, five popular machine learning methods, including support vector machine, decision tree, random forest and two other convolution neural networks, are used for comparison. According to the results, the proposed method achieves better comprehensive performance with the highest diagnostic accuracy and convergence speed.

articleTitle: Optimization of distribution network topology based on CIM model
abstract: With the continuous development and expansion of the distribution network, the access of new energy makes the distribution network topology continue to expand, which will eventually cause the distribution network structure to become more complex and bloated, and many topology problems avoided at the beginning of planning are also increasingly apparent. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an optimization scheme of distribution network topology based on common information model (CIM). Firstly, the original CIM data is simplified and reconstructed, and the topology related information is extracted, which greatly reduces the data storage scale, simplifies the operation mode, and provides conditions for the subsequent large-scale application. Secondly, five definitions of typical distribution network topology problems are proposed, and the specific network optimization scheme is proposed to reduce the number of households in power outage. Finally, the actual grid data of a city in southern China is taken as an example to verify the scheme, and the final optimization result is also recognized by the front-line engineers, which shows that the grid optimization scheme proposed in this paper can effectively identify the grid problems existing in the distribution network reliability.

articleTitle: Corrected Complex Torque Coefficient Method for Small-Signal Stability Analysis of Grid-Connected VSC
abstract: This paper focuses on the damping characteristics of sub-synchronous oscillations of phase locked loop (PLL) of grid-connected voltage source converter (VSC). A 6th order frequency domain model including the PLL, the inner current control loop and the grid dynamics is built. Compared to the model of synchronous generator, it is found that the classic complex torque coefficient method is not entirely suitable for PLL stability analysis. The method is corrected, and the concepts of corrected damping coefficient and corrected synchronizing coefficient are proposed. Based on the method, the impact of other control loops on the damping, such as current control loop (CC) and grid dynamics, can be quantitatively studied with the corrected damping torque superimposing to the PLL. The overall impact of each control loop on the damping can also be evaluated through this method. The method is validated through both eigenvalue analyses and time domain simulations.

articleTitle: Detection and Rapid Positioning of Abnormal Noise of GIS Based on Acoustic Imaging Technology
abstract: In recent years, abnormal noises of GIS equipment in operation in substations have occurred. Some abnormal noises can easily lead to equipment faults, and it is necessary to find and deal with them in time. The traditional vibration signal analysis method detects mechanical faults by measuring vibrations of single point on the shell which is difficult to fully reflect the mechanical condition of the device. In view of the characteristic that the acoustic array composed of directional sound intensity probes can measure the sound field distribution characteristics of GIS equipment shells, this paper adopts the GIS sound field measurement and imaging system that acquires the sound wave signal through the microphone array and processes it based on the delay and sum beam forming algorithm to conduct live detection of abnormal noise in two GIS substations, and locate the abnormal vibration source, determine the abnormal vibration components, which verifies the effectiveness of the live detection based on acoustic imaging in judging and locating the abnormal vibration of GIS.

articleTitle: Federated Learning-Based Forecasting Model for PV Power Generations Considering Privacy Protection and Data Sharing
abstract: Forecasting the power of photovoltaic (PV) power stations through big data and machine learning has gradually become one of the main technical means of power prediction of PV power stations. The data sharing of multiple PV power stations in the same area can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of power generation. However, data integration often brings about problems of information security and data privacy. In order to solve the problem that data sharing and privacy protection can not be balanced, a PV power prediction model based on federated learning is proposed in this paper. On the premise of ensuring the information security of each local power data, the collection of decentralized data and joint multi-party data are constructed. At the same time, under the condition that the data of each power station are confidential to each other, the federated server collects the encrypted training parameters of each power station after local training for integration training, and makes PV power generation prediction without sacrificing security and privacy of the power station. The result shows the prospect of federated learning for forecasting the power of photovoltaic power stations without compromising privacy.

articleTitle: ROBUST DYNAMIC ECONOMIC DISPATCH SOLUTION IN A WIND-HYDRO-THERMAL POWER SYSTEM
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid increase of large-scale installed wind power capacity and the continuous improvement of utilization level, the random and intermittent characteristics of wind power output have brought many adverse effects on the power system. Therefore, how to effectively restrain the fluctuation of wind power output and improve the wind power penetration level has always been a hot and difficult issue in the academia and industry. In this paper, a robust dynamic economic dispatch model in a wind-hydro-thermal power system is proposed, aiming to minimize the generation cost of conventional thermal-hydro power units, whilst meeting corresponding system operation constraints. A polyhedral uncertainty set with the adjustable robust coefficient by introducing the confidence interval of wind power output is established to describe the wind power uncertainty, and a complementary and coordinated dispatch strategy is elaborately designed to restrain the fluctuation of thermal power. Given that the proposed optimization model bears the highly nonlinear characteristics, an improved grey wolf optimizer is utilized for the solution of the proposed optimization model. Finally, the correctness and validity of the proposed model and dispatch strategy are verified by the simulation analysis performed on the IEEE New England 39-bus test system.

articleTitle: Subsynchronous Control Interaction: Real-World Events and Practical Impedance Reshaping Controls
abstract: The power electronic converters have enabled the harnessing of electrical energy from renewable resources, such as wind and solar. However, the power electronic converter-based devices can interact with other grid components and lead to unstable oscillation in a wide frequency range, for instance, the subsynchronous and high-frequency oscillations. In the past decade, several subsynchronous control interaction (SSCI) events have been reported, for instance, in the Xcel Energy, ERCOT, Guyuan, and Hami wind power systems. This chapter first provides a brief overview of the occurrence mechanisms and features of various real-world SSCI events. Then, it discusses the practical impedance reshaping mitigation control schemes. The practical installation experience of both generator-side and grid-side impedance reshaping control techniques is provided, which enhances the confidence to practically implement these schemes in the actual power systems that are facing similar challenges. Finally, recommended guidelines and research prospects in the analysis and mitigation are provided.

articleTitle: GRID CODE FORMULATION RECOMMENDATIONS ON INVERTER-BASED GENERATION DURING ASYMMETRICAL GRID FAULTS
abstract: In recent grid codes (e.g., German grid codes) for inverter-based generation (IBG), dual-sequence reactive current injection during asymmetrical grid faults has been stipulated. Due to the interconnection of the positive- and negative-sequence networks during asymmetrical faults, a positive-sequence reactive current injection (over-excited) can lift both positive- and negative-sequence voltages, while a negative-sequence reactive current injection (under-excited) can reduce both. Therefore, a compromise should be reached to meet the grid code requirements. While injecting current during grid faults, it has been reported that IBG is likely to lose synchronism with the grid due to the grid impedance interaction, in particular in a weak grid scenario. This is commonly referred to as synchronization instability. In this paper, a quantitative analysis is carried out to identify the maximum current injection for IBG under different types of asymmetrical faults, giving the dual-sequence current injection limit considering the interconnection of the sequence networks. Based on quantitative results, whether the current grid codes can be generally followed in a weak grid scenario is evaluated. Additionally, recommendations are provided on the reasonable regulation of the proportional coefficients between the amplitude of the current output and the voltage. The analysis results are verified by simulations.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of graphic user interface for real-time wind farm simulation platform
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of software about a graphic user interface designed for a real-time wind farm simulation platform. It includes four functions(parameter pre-processing, simulation control, real-time data visualization, parameter post-processing, respectively). The parameter pre-processing is responsible for the modification of the module parameter. The simulation control is responsible for the start-stop of real-time simulation. The real-time data visualization is responsible for receiving real-time data from the external hardware simulator and generating images. The parameter postprocessing is responsible for the analysis of simulation data. This software aims to assist researchers in implementing the realtime simulation of wind farm conveniently and quickly. This software uses QT as the development framework so that it has cross-platform feature. The main part of the software is developed by C++. Hence, the running speed is fast. Some of the postprocessing functions are developed by Python. Hence, the development is convenient. In addition, this software is a userfriendly graphical user interface because it is convenient and reduces the time cost of using external executable software.

articleTitle: STABILITY ANALYSIS of GRID-CONNECTED CONVERTERS in LOW-VOLTAGE DISTRIBUTION NETWORK
abstract: As more and more power electronic equipment is connected to the low-voltage distribution network, the stability of the equipment needs to arouse people's attention. With the development of renewable energy, grid-connected converter (GCC) is the most common power electronic equipment as the interface unit. Therefore, this article takes the three-phase LCL type GCC as the research object, and explores the factors that affect the three-phase LCL type GCC in the low-voltage distribution network. First, the dq impedance model of the three-phase GCC is established. Secondly, the factors that may affect the stability are analyzed by the impedance stability criterion. Finally, it is verified by simulation that the line parameters of the low-voltage distribution network have almost no effect on the stability of the three-phase LCL type GCC. But when the three-phase LCL type GCC increases the output power and the number of parallel three-phase GCCs increases, the stability will deteriorate. As a consequence, it is necessary to limit the output power and the number of parallel-connected converters in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of PV-Battery Grid-Connected Power System
abstract: As the technology advances, there is a tremendous growth in power demand, depletion of fossil fuel resources, a rise in global warming and power crisis in many countries. Owing to this, a photovoltaic-battery hybrid system that is proposed in this research work as a measure to assist the independent power providers to supply a continuous and reliable electricity to a number of households at a low cost of energy. The hybrid system comprises of photovoltaic (PV) system, energy storage facility and utility grid. The PV system is utilized to convert the natural endowed solar resources into electricity with the application of solar panels. The excess electricity generated from the solar panels can be stored with the utilization of a battery system. The battery system is charged by either the solar power via the maximum power point tracking technique (MPPT) module or by the utility grid during off-peak periods. This research work presents the system modelling and MATLAB/Simulink simulations of a grid-connected photovoltaic and battery based hybrid system. The proposed hybrid system can result in significant cost reduction as the electricity bill of the consumer is reduced and promotes an energy balance in the power system.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Protection Design of PWM Converter
abstract: This paper addresses the current problem of less protection for power electronics such as PWM rectifiers. A simulation model is developed for the closed-loop PWM converter and its internal overvoltage and overcurrent are analyzed under two fault conditions, i.e., IGBT pulse fault and external short circuit. By comparing the rectifier and the inverter, we found that the PWM rectifier overvoltage is more significant. We then used this to design the corresponding trigger protection with overcurrent as the signal control pulse and circuit breaker and the matching protection for overvoltage with the lightning arrester-like principle. Our design restores 1.5 times the overvoltage of 1200V to 937V and suppresses 105A overcurrent to 846A.

articleTitle: OPTIMISATION OF GENERATORS RESTARTING SEQUENCE CONSIDERING OPERATION STATE SWITCH OF PHOTOVOLTAIC AND ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM
abstract: With the increasing proportion of photovoltaic and energy storage systems in the power grid, photovoltaic and energy storage power stations (PESPS) can be employed as black-start power sources to increase the number of black-start power sources in the power grid and improve the power grid restoration efficiency. However, the existing studies that use PESPS as blackstart power source mainly focus on restarting sequence of the conventional thermal generators without considering the operation state of PESPS during system restoration, which decrease system restoration efficiency. Therefore, an optimization method of generators restarting sequence is proposed in this paper considering operation state switch of PESPS. The PEPES is equipped with a certain capacity of energy storage as the black start power source. The optimization model of generator restarting sequence was established to maximize the total restored power during system restoration. Meanwhile, the optimal restarting strategy are generated with the constraints of the operation state switch of PESPS, output characteristics of photovoltaic power station and the constraints of power flow, transient frequency and recovery path. Then, the artificial bee colony algorithm is employed to solve the optimization model. Finally, the modified IEEE39 node system is employed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: COMPARATIVE STABILITY ASSESSMENT OF GRID-FOLLOWING AND GRID-FORMING VSCS IN WEAK GRIDS
abstract: Under the high renewables penetrated and high power electronics dominated (“double high”) power systems, the wide-band oscillation problems of grid-following VSCs integrated into weak grids have brought severe challenges to the safe and stable operation of the system. To further investigate the stability of VSCs with different control schemes, namely the grid-following VSC and the grid-forming VSC, the small-signal sequence impedance models of the two types of VSCs are derived, and the sequence impedance characteristics of grid-following and grid-following VSCs are compared and analysed. The sequence impedance of the grid-following VSCs is primarily capacitive with high amplitude in the middle-frequency band while the sequence impedance of the grid-forming VSCs is mainly inductive with low amplitude. Based on the sequence impedance models of two types of VSCs, the stability of these two types of VSCs integrated into weak grids is also analysed. The results indicate that the grid-following VSCs are prone to sub/super synchronous oscillations in weak grids while the grid-forming VSCs are able to operate stably in weak grids. Finally, electromagnetic transient simulations are conducted to validate the sequence impedance models and the stability assessment.

articleTitle: OPTIMAL PORTFOLIO AND BIDDING STRATEGY FOR DER AGGREGATORS PARTICIPATING IN VARIOUS ANCILLARY SERVICES TRANSACTIONS
abstract: As one of the most important entities trading in the ancillary services market, the distributed energy resources (DER) aggregators can bid in the market via aggregating the available capacity of the DER. It is essential for the DER aggregators to bid in an optimal way so as to maximize their profits. Heretofore, however, most of the existing studies focus on the issue that the DER aggregators just utilize a single type of DER to participate in a single breed of ancillary service transaction, which cannot fully explore the potential of DER participating in ancillary services market and expand the profit space of the DER aggregators. To this end, this paper proposes an optimal bidding strategy for the DER aggregators participating in different kinds of ancillary services transactions with various DER which include energy storage system (ESS), electrical vehicle (EV), distributed generation (DG), and demand response (DR). Firstly, the characteristics of different kinds of DER and ancillary services are analysed. Secondly, based on the characteristic analysis results, an optimal classification and portfolio method for these DER participating in different kinds of ancillary services transactions is proposed. The uncertainty of market prices is considered, and the optimal bidding model is constructed by using stochastic programming aiming at maximizing its expected profit. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by a simulation based on the PJM trading rules.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of integrated energy system considering demand response of autonomous electric taxi
abstract: Integrated Energy System (IES) combines electricity, gas, heat and other energy sources to meet users' energy needs while improving energy efficiency. In this paper, an optimal IES scheduling method under high penetration of renewable energy is proposed, in which the coordination operation of renewable energy generation, energy coupling equipment, multi-energy load and autonomous electric taxi (AET) cluster is considered. Under the condition of meeting the travel demand of regional residents, the demand response of AET cluster based on electricity price and incentive is embedded into IES optimal scheduling, which makes the whole system run more economical and flexible. Finally, an IES optimal scheduling model considering energy purchase cost, carbon emission cost, renewable energy power curtailment cost and incentive cost is proposed and solved with the solver CPLEX. The economy and reliability of the proposed optimal scheduling method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: REVIEW OF SUPPRESSION STRATEGIES FOR HIGH-FREQUENCY OSCILLATIONS IN MMC-HVDC SYSTEMS
abstract: Modular multilevel converter based high-voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) transmission has been widely used in the applications of large-scale wind farm integration and interconnection of power grids around the world, thanks to its superior performance. However, in recent years, the high-frequency oscillation (HFO) phenomena frequently occurred in practical MMC-HVDC systems in China. The academia and industry have recently made great efforts to suppress the HFOs. This paper reveals the HFO mechanism first and then reviews the existing HFO suppression strategies. The principle of each HFO suppression strategy is introduced and the corresponding impedance characteristics and stability of MMC-HVDC are then analysed. Moreover, the comparison among those HFO suppression strategies is made. In the end, the future research directions are also suggested.

articleTitle: Harmonic Power Flow Calculation Method based on General Model of Harmonic Source
abstract: With the continuous development of renewable energy and power electronic technology, new power generation equipment and converter s have brought up new power quality problems to the distribution network, among which the harmoni c problem is the most prominent. Aiming at the problem of harmonic power flow in distribution network, a harmonic power flow calculation method for distribution network based on the general model of harmonic source is proposed. This method uses the L-M method to calculate the network power flow at the fundamental frequency, and establishes a general harmonic source model based on the network topology. The harmonic source is regarded as a single port unknown network and t he voltage current relationship in time domain is transformed into a frequency domain expression. With the superposition theorem and the trigonometric relationship, the matrix relationship of the general model of harmonic sources is established. The harmonic admittance equation and harmoni c source model equation of the system are solved simultaneously to obtain the harmonic power flow of the system without complicated iterative process. The time domain simulation is established in PSCAD/EMTDC to prove the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Real Time Equivalent Modeling Method for Wind Farms Based on Wind Speed Forecast
abstract: In the power systems analysis with large scale wind power, equivalent wind farm models can reduce computational complexity and improve simulation efficiency while ensuring the accuracy of analysis results. This paper proposes a real time equivalent modeling method based on wind power forecast to obtain the equival ent model of the wind farm for online analysis. First, the ARIMA (Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average) model is used to predict the wind speed and direction of the wind farm. Then use the predicted results to cluster the wind turbines in the wind far m and update the wind farm equivalent model according to the clustering results. Thus, a model that can adapt to the online wind conditions can be obtained. In addition, the wind turbine clustering adopts the quantum particle swarm improved fuzzy c means a lgorithm (FCM QPSO), which has a strong global results searchability. Finally, the wind speed data of an actual wind farm is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A CHARGING STATION PLANNING MODEL CONSIDERING THE CHARGING BEHAVIOR OF PRIVATE CAR USERS
abstract: In order to solve the planning problem of newly-built electric vehicle charging stations (EVCSs) reasonably on the basis of existing charging stations, this paper proposes a charging station planning model considering the charging habits of electric vehicle private users. Firstly, according to the users' charging data, the probability density distribution function of the user's charging start time, charging duration and the user's charging station selection behavior matrix are obtained. Then, the queuing simulation model and charging station selection model of EVCS are established. Then, “V” diagram used to divide charging station service area and using Monte Carlo simulation method to get charging demand point spatial distribution, comprehensive consideration to EVCS in construction operation cost and by charging demand point location charging station on the way to New Year takes the target of minimizing the sum of the cost function, to solve the optimal location of the new charging stations. Finally, taking a charging station planning for electric private cars in a city of North China as an example, the simulation results show that the proposed model and method are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: RENEWABLE ENERGY TIME-SERIES PRODUCTION SIMULATION METHOD CONSIDERING PUMPED-STORAGE
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy power generation, the volatility of renewable energy power generation output puts higher requirements on the power system operation and regulation capability. Pumped-storage is an effective means to improve the flexibility of system operation and promote the accommodation of renewable energy. Affected by the uncertainty of renewable energy power output and energy storage capacity, the power limitations of pumped-storage, accurate quantification of the effect of pumped-storage in promoting renewable energy accommodation requires time-series simulation calculations. This paper studies the mechanism of pumped-storage to promote renewable energy accommodation. Pumped-storage can directly or indirectly increase the accommodation space of renewable energy by energy storage, providing spinning reserve and peak regulation. Based on the above research results, a time-series simulation model of renewable energy accommodation capacity considering pumped-storage was constructed. A case analysis of the model based on actual operating data verifies that the proposed method can realize the quantitative calculation of the pumped-storage to promote the accommodation of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic frequency characteristics and influencing factors of power system with high RESs
abstract: A high level of renewable energy sources (RESs) has reduced the system inertia, resulting in the increasing risk of system frequency stability. It is of great significance to study the dynamic frequency characteristic of the power system with high RESs and the RESs participating in frequency regulation of the system to improve the frequency stability. In order to improve the frequency response of the system with high RESs, the virtual inertia control and droop control are combined to make the RESs have the inertia characteristic and droop characteristic similar to the synchronous generators (SGs). Then, a dynamic frequency response model of a power system with high RESs is firstly established to analyze the dynamic frequency characteristic and the analytical solution of system frequency index based on the proposed model is calculated. The effect of RESs participating in frequency regulation is compared, and the impact of frequency regulation parameters on dynamic characteristics of system frequency is studied, such as load disturbance level, RESs droop gain, the virtual time constant, and the share of RESs. The analysis results of this paper can provide a reference value for the frequency control of power system with high RESs.

articleTitle: DIFFERENTIAL OPTIMIZATION PLANNING METHOD FOR CAPACITY-LOAD RATIO OF DISTRIBUTION NETWORK BASED ON MAXIMUM LOAD UTILIZATION HOURS
abstract: In order to improve the lean level of the distribution network and lead the high-quality and high-efficiency development of the distribution network from the perspective of precise planning, it is an inevitable trend for future planning technology development to set planning goals differentiated according to actual conditions. In view of the insufficient selection of capacity-load ratio in the current technical principles of distribution network planning and design, this paper proposes a differential optimization planning method for capacity-load ratio of distribution network based on maximum load utilization hours. Firstly, we convert the equivalent utilization hours of the maximum load based on the actual annual power consumption. Then we determine the optimal load rate range under the economic operation of the transformer in the planned area. Finally, we combine the average annual load growth rate to obtain the capacity-load ratio of the area optimal range. Taking a typical area in Anhui Province as an example, the planning method proposed in this paper is verified. The results show that the planning results of this method are consistent with the current situation of the distribution network, which improves the lean level of distribution network planning and can improve the quality of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of the VSC Access Location When Connected to a LCC-HVDC Infeed System
abstract: Voltage Source Converter (VSC) has been widely used recently. However, fewer researches forced on the VSC access location when connected to a Line Commutated Converter based High Voltage DC transmission (LCC-HVDC) infeed system. Therefore, this paper proposes an evaluation method to solve it. Firstly, based on the small-signal modes of VSC and LCC, and Jacobian transfer matrix (JTM), an impedance based effective short-circuit ratio (IESCR) is given. Then, considering the normal operation and N-1 operation state, evaluation indexes including IESCR, which are used to assess the AC system, LCC-HVDC and VSC respectively, are proposed. Subsequently, the evaluation method is established based on the linear weighted model. Thereafter, a model based on IEEE 39-node model is given. The evaluation method is used to analyse 3 typical VSC access locations, and the optimal result among them is obtained. Finally, based on the requirements of Henan power grid, the evaluation method is used to achieve the reform of the AC line into VSC-HVDC, and the optimal method is given.

articleTitle: An improved stochastic approach for PV's hosting capacity assessment based on binary search
abstract: In this paper, an improved stochastic approach for PV hosting capacity assessment based on binary search is proposed. Firstly, the framework of traditional stochastic approach for PV hosting capacity assessment is introduced. Then, the key principles of binary search-based stochastic simulation is proposed and calculation procedure is presented. Finally, the verification is performed on a field practice test bed in China.

articleTitle: INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICITY PORTRAIT BASED ON IMPROVED K-MEANS CLUSTERING ALGORITHM
abstract: With the deepening of big data research and the construction of distribution network automation, power big data is getting more and more attention. How to realize the perception of power network users based on the big data of distribution network and support the related business of distribution network is the key issue that power companies pay attention to at present. In this paper, the annual row data of users are pre-processed, and the electricity consumption data are clustered by improved k-means algorithm. Then combined with the user's industry information, through the Granger causality test and other algorithms, the industry electricity from the characteristics of electricity and power driving effect of the two dimensions of the portrait; Finally, based on the actual data, the industry electricity portrait is realized, and the effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: RESEARCH ON RISK MANAGEMENT OF ENERGY CHAIN BASED ON INTERVAL SET PAIR THEORY
abstract: As the China government already putting forward the strategic objectives to peak carbon dioxide emissions before 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality before 2060, social consensus of green low carbon has promoted the development of integrated energy services. As an emerging format, integrated energy services break the trade and technical barriers between different varieties of energy. As a carrier of integrated energy services, integrated energy service companies still have many problems in their own optimized operation. This paper studies the risk mechanism of energy chain considering the risk preference of energy service companies, and analyses the correlation between the risk preference of energy service companies and the risk of energy chain. Based on set pair theory and interval number, the paper establishes an energy chain risk assessment model to overcome the shortcomings of traditional evaluation methods, which is able to characterize risk appetite and uncertainties. Finally, the results of simulation and tests verify the effectiveness of the proposed method of the novel.

articleTitle: ANALYSIS ON ERROR TEST OF PV MODEL BASED ON DC-DC CONVERTER
abstract: DC-DC module of full digital simulation, the author of this paper and the actual controller in the loop simulation, comparing the results from the dynamic response and steady-state error Angle consider implementing error less than 5%, the dynamic error is included in the voltage, current and PV MPPT conditions change model of adjusting time, overshoot and rise time, steady-state error is mainly including the system stability of accuracy. Typical test conditions are designed as follows:(1) Steady-state error test: measure the deviation between the voltage, current, power value of the system and the controller in the loop under the condition of full digital simulation.(2) Dynamic response test: measure the adjustment time and overshoot of the full digital simulation and the controller in the loop under the condition of light intensity and temperature change.

articleTitle: Impact of High-Proportion Wind Power Integration on Power Angle Stability of Power System
abstract: In the context of carbon emission peak and carbon neutrality, accelerating the development of new energy has become an inevitable trend. With the rapid development of wind power generation, the proportion of wind power integrated to grid is increasing, which significantly affects the dynamic characteristics of the power system dominated by synchronous generators (SG). The impact of high-proportion wind power integration on power system angle stability is studied in this paper. The extended equal area criterion (EEAC) is applied to reveal the influence mechanisms of wind farm integration distance, low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) transient characteristics and LVRT recovery characteristics on the power system angle stability. On this basis, measures to improve the power angle stability of single-terminal delivery system is given from the perspectives of the proportion of wind power integration, active and reactive power generated by wind farm during the fault. Finally, the correctness of the above theoretical analysis is verified by time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Pre-Calculation of Wind Turbine Blade Fatigue Damage by Machine Learning
abstract: Blade fatigue failure poses a great threat to the safe and stable operation of wind turbines. To solve the problem that the existing fatigue damage calculation methods are difficult to balance the calculation accuracy and calculation speed, a LightGBM machine learning fatigue damage calculation method is proposed. The method mainly analyses the blade 3D model by finite element software to determine the blade fatigue dangerous nodes and the stress magnitude corresponding to the unit load at the nodes, then uses Von Mises yield criterion to convert the load time series data into equivalent force time series data, and applies the rain-flow counting method and linear fatigue cumulative damage theory to calculate the blade fatigue damage amount. Finally, on the basis of the obtained minute-level blade fatigue damage amount, LightGBM machine learning algorithm is applied to train the fatigue damage calculation model, inputting wind speed, air density, turbulence intensity, wind shear and other wind parameters as well as the inflow angle and other wind turbine operation conditions, which can output the blade fatigue damage amount correspondingly. The proposed fatigue damage calculation method is evaluated to be highly accurate and feasible.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy to Suppress Torque Oscillations for Brushless Doubly-Fed Induction Generator under Asymmetrical Grid Faults
abstract: Due to the advantages of high reliability and low maintenance cost, the brushless doubly-fed induction generator (BDFIG) has shown promising prospect in the application for wind energy conversion system. The low voltage ride-through capability of wind turbines is one of the most important requirements in the grid codes of many countries. Under grid voltage asymmetrical dip, the electromagnetic torque of BDFIG would contains large oscillations which are very harmful to the wind turbine and even can lead to the destruction of mechanical parts. To address such problem, this paper proposes a control strategy to suppress the torque oscillations of BDFIG under asymmetrical grid faults and the effectiveness of proposed control is validated through simulated studies for a 2 MW BDFIG based wind generation system. The results demonstrate that the proposed control can effectively suppress the torque oscillations and improve the fault ride-through capability of BDFIG based wind turbine system.

articleTitle: NICKEL HYDROXIDE DECORATED GRAPHENE NANOHYBRIDS FOR SUPERCAPACITORS
abstract: Limited by poor conductivity and high internal resistance, pure Ni(OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> employed as an electrode could cause obvious voltage drop and low charge-discharge efficiency. Decorating Ni(OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on the surface of graphene oxide (GO) could improve the conductivity and reduce polarization of Ni(OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Meanwhile, the problem of low specific capacity of GO can also be solved. In this paper, Ni(OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> decorated graphene nanohybrids were prepared by hydrothermal method with NiSO4 as the precursor, and the effect of Ni(OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> content on the electrochemical performance of the sample was studied. The prepared electrodes can be applied to high-capacity and high-power supercapacitors.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of canceling tap changer for UHVDC
abstract: In UHVDC project, converter tap changer is an important equipment to ensure equipment safety and maintain economic operation. However, in actual operation of DC system, changes of DC power and AC system may lead to high frequency action of tap changer. This paper mainly studies two different control strategies of canceling tap changer. Firstly, the mechanism of tap changer action is analyzed, Then, the feasibility of canceling tap changer strategy under two different control strategies is studied from the aspects of reactive power consumption, no-load ideal voltage at valve side, insulation level and converter valve angle. The research results provide reference value for canceling converter tap changer in UHVDC project.

articleTitle: RESEARCH ON RESONANT INTERACTION CHARACTERISTICS AND CONVERTER “BLACK BOX” MODELLING METHOD OF DC DISTRIBUTION NETWORK
abstract: With the development of DC distribution network and the increase of distributed power supply in distribution network, the interaction between distributed power supply and constant power load in DC distribution network has attracted wide attention. In addition, due to commercial competition, user’s information protection and other factors, there are many “black box” converters in the distribution network, which hinders the stability analysis of the system. In this paper, DC distribution network with distributed power supply, energy storage equipment and constant power load is established, and the interaction characteristics of the system are derived when the output port of distributed power converter is equivalent to the parallel impedance of current source. Secondly, a black-box converter modelling method is proposed to obtain the equivalent transfer function of the converter under the condition that the key information such as circuit topology cannot be obtained, and the simulation results are verified.

articleTitle: Arm Inductor and Modulation Index Design of Full-bridge Modular Multilevel Converters for Capacitor Voltage Ripples Reduction
abstract: In case of over-modulation operations, the full-bridge submodule (FBSM) capacitance of FBSM-based modular multilevel converters (FB-MMCs) can be reduced significantly. However, the filter inductance, including the arm inductance and the leakage inductance of a transformer, has a great impact on the FBSM voltage fluctuations. This paper analyzes the FBSM voltage ripples characterization of the FB-MMC with consideration of the filter inductance, and the analysis results show that the fundamental frequency component, which is dominant in the FBSM voltage fluctuations, can almost be completely eliminated by selecting appropriate arm inductor and modulation index. Furthermore, the optimal arm inductor and modulation index are also derived in order to reduce the energy storage requirements. Simulation results on a ±160 kV/1000 MW FB-MMC verify the validity of the proposed design method.

articleTitle: Robust decision-making optimization model of household micro-energy system under uncertain environment
abstract: Photovoltaic(PV) energy is often used in household micro-energy systems as distributed energy due to its clean, simple and convenient characteristics. However, due to its highly volatility and intermittency, PV energy output has brought a lot of uncertain factors to the operation of household micro-energy systems. In order to promote the consumption of PV energy, this paper proposes a robust decision-making optimization model for Home Energy Management System(HEMS) under uncertain environments. First, the robust optimization method is adopted with the goal of minimizing the investment and operating cost, and the family robust optimization control model including flexible load is established. Then through the Fenchel-Lagrange duality theory, the robust optimization model with uncentain variables is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming model with certain variables, and the uncertainty problem is transformed into a linear programming problem for solution. Finally, a numerical example illustrates that this method can improve the utilization of PV energy while satisfying consumer preferences, thus verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring of Wind Turbine Converter based on a Two-stage Data Augmentation Scheme
abstract: Converter is one of the most important components in wind turbines. SCADA data from normal operation status is usually used to train a ML (Machine Learning) model to monitor the condition of converters online. But unless there is a fault phenomenon of parameters, it is difficult to judge whether the convertor is in normal operation status. Therefore, although there are huge amount of operation data, the confirmed normal operation data is usually not enough to train a reasonable Normal Behaviours Model (NBM). In this paper, a condition monitoring method for converter combining a two-stage data augmentation scheme is proposed. In this scheme, a Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) is adopted to augment the available normal condition SCADA data, then a NBM is trained using the augmented data to filter the ambiguous data i.e., the operation condition of the data is unknown. The filtered data combined with the normal condition data is fed into the second stage GAN to further augment the training data. In this way, the NBM could be fully developed for online monitoring of converter. Case studies for several wind turbines located in Northwest China verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Compared with SCADA system, the proposed method could provide the fault alarm at least one month in advance.

articleTitle: RESEARCH ON DYNAMIC RESPONSE CHARACTERISTICS OF PHOTOVOLTAIC DC BOOST COLLECTION SYSTEM
abstract: With flexible power transmission capacity, photovoltaic DC boost collection system has become an effective solution to building energy interconnection between large-scale photovoltaic renewable energy and AC power grid. In this paper, the DC boost collection technology is used as a breakthrough, and RTDS real-time simulation is used as a hardware tool to deeply study the dynamic operation characteristics, mathematical model principle and whole distribution network coordinated control strategy of the system. By building photovoltaic DC-DC and DC-AC structure simulation model basing on MMC structure, the dynamic response characteristics of each part are compared and analyzed, the accuracy of the model and response is also verified. Meanwhile, based on the actual control system device, the hardware in the loop simulation test environment is constructed with RTDS simulation system. Given the step response under the same condition, the adjustment time under the dynamic response is tested to meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Two-stage Energy Management Strategy for Hydrogen Energy Storage System Embedded Microgrids
abstract: With ever increased penetration level of renewable generation in microgrids, there is an urgent need to address the associated uncertainty and power fluctuation issues. Hydrogen energy storage system (HESS) has emerged and become a promising solution in serving as energy buffer. To tackle the power balancing problem, converting the surplus electricity from renewable sources to other forms of energy is considered as a cost-effective measure. To this end, this paper proposes a hybrid energy management strategy for hydrogen energy storage system (HESS) embedded microgrids, which consists of day-ahead and intra-day operating stages. In the proposed model, the uncertainties associated with renewable generation, electrical load, and hydrogen demand are explicitly considered. We construct a comprehensive HESS model relying on the basic principles that the surplus electricity can be stored in the form of hydrogen in case of abundant renewable generation, and electricity can be generated through hydrogen fuel cells otherwise. Moreover, to ensure the optimization performance, we propose a flexible weighted-MPC method to solve the receding horizon optimization problem at the intra-day stage. The operational effectiveness of the proposed energy management strategy are verified through extensive case studies.

articleTitle: ANGLE STABILITY ENHANCEMENT OF OFF-GRID MICROGRIDS BASED ON MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL
abstract: To compensate for the lack of inertia and damping, virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control which mimic the synchronous generator (SG) is applied to converters of distributed generation. The synchronous operation of SG and multi-VSG are more likely not be maintained after a large disturbance due to the difference of frequency regulation for the VSG and SG. The rotor motion equations of SG and VSG combination as well as multi-VSG combination are established based on the VSG common reference frame. On this basis, the angle stability of an off-grid microgrid is analyzed and the impact of the controlled current source model of energy storage system (ESS) on transient stability is investigated. A model predictive control (MPC) method using ESS is proposed to enhance the angle stability of the off-gird microgrid. By establishing the prediction model of angle difference, angular frequency difference, and ESS output power and designing the cost function to minimize angle and angular frequency difference and variations of reference power as control variables, the reference active and reactive power can be optimized and then transmit to ESS. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed MPC method using ESS to enhance the angle stability of off-grid microgrid after large disturbances in the system.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching of Power Grid Containing Wind Power Integration Based on Stochastic Model Predictive Control
abstract: In view of the huge challenges brought by the continuous and rapid increase in the scale of wind power grid connection to the operation stability and dispatch economy of the power system, a joint dispatch model with load response based on stochastic model predictive control is proposed, and the adjustable load is introduced to increa se the system. Scheduling capability. Construct an objective function for minimizing the cost of joint dispatch based on load response, as well as including unit capacity and minimum technical output constraints, output limitation constraints, and climbing capacity constraints, load response scheduling constraints, climbing constraints, cumulative upper and lower limits of load response, etc. constraint. A number of typical scenarios are used to express the uncertainty of the system, and simulation examples verify that the flexibility of load response plays an important role in improving the economy of system operation.

articleTitle: THE MOTH FLAME OPTIMIZED ELM ALGORITHM IN DISTRIBUTED GENERATION PLANNING CONSIDERING DIFFERENT INTEREST BALANCE
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power in the distribution network, the contradiction of demands among power users, distribution companies and independent operators has become increasingly prominent. In order to carry out the planning of distributed wind power development and installation site in an orderly and efficient way, based on improving the economic benefits of distributed wind power operation, this paper establishes a multi-objective distributed power planning model under different interest balance from the perspective of different stakeholders, and uses the moth flame optimized ELM algorithm to solve the model. taking ieee 33 node as an example, the effectiveness of distributed wind power planning based on the moth flame optimized ELM algorithm is verified, and the superiority of the method proposed in this paper is further demonstrated by comparing with the data calculated by NSGA-II optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: ANALYSIS OF IMPACT OF DIFFERENT CONTROL LINKS ON THE WIDEBAND IMPEDANCE CHARACTERISTICS OF MODULAR MULTILEVEL CONVERTER
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been widely used in high-voltage dc (HVDC) transmission and other high-power applications, due to its superior performance. However, sub-/super-synchronous oscillation and high-frequency resonance phenomena frequently occurred in practical MMC-HVDC systems in recent years. Many researchers have recently made efforts to reveal and suppress the oscillations in specific frequency ranges. The impedance-based analysis method has been widely applied. Nonetheless, there is still lack of detailed analysis of impacts of different control links on the wideband impedance characteristics of MMC, which will be the focus of this paper. First, the detailed wideband impedance model of MMC including all control links and internal harmonic dynamics is established by using harmonic state-space (HSS) modelling method, which is validated by frequency scanning in simulation. Based on this, how each control link affects the wideband impedance characteristics of MMC is elaborated. The results can be a reference for the MMC control system design and simplifying the wideband impedance model for a specific oscillation analysis.

articleTitle: THE APPLICATION OF THE WEBSOCKET-BASED REAL-TIME DATA-DRIVEN ANALYZING SYSTEM IN DISTRIBUTION MONITORING
abstract: With the rapid development of communication methods and Web3.0 real-time network system standards maturity, the network system architecture and information transmission's requirements change. The traditional Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) system is facing new challenges. However, the IIoT has its new opportunities during the development. The key challenges of traditional IIoT are mass data approaching and digging data value from diverse data-source. In the conventional IIoT system, threshold alarm and direct data display are common approach methods for manually processing while the data scale is not mass. However, the information entropy decreases so fast that the data value did not be well dug. Therefore, to address these limitations in distribution monitoring, we attempt to design a WebSocket-based real-time data-driven analyzing system for distribution monitoring. We adopt WebSocket protocol docking with ModBus protocol for data-collection to achieve multiple device's data-parallel transmission performances in the protocol layer. On the other hand, we propose a cloud-edge-mixed-analyzing architecture for digging data-value to satisfy the comprehensive analysis of different category device-data in different physical areas. And we give a use-case of this system. Finally, we have done three data processing experiments to illustrate the superiority of our approach.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Yaw Control of Wind Farms
abstract: The wake effect of wind farms is one of the main factors causing a reduction in the power output. Cooperative yaw control has the potential to mitigate wake effects and increase the overall output power of the wind farm. Optimizing the yaw control strategy is challenging, due to the large number of degrees-of-freedom and interaction of wake flow in the farm. Here a genetic algorithm is applied, using the Baskankhah and Porté -Agel yawed wake model, and seeking to maximize the overall output power of the wind farm as the optimization objective. Performance is demonstrated on a reference wind farm containing 49 wind turbines of two different types. The increase in wind farm power due to cooperative yaw optimization is 1%-2%. When the wake effect is particularly strong, the maximum is up to 10%. The optimal yaw angle of the upstream wind turbine is larger than that of the middle wind turbine, while the downstream wind turbine may not yaw.

articleTitle: MODELING AND FAULT ANALYSIS FOR DC MICROGRID INTEGRATION OF PV, BATTERY/WIND ENERGY CONVERSION SYSTEM
abstract: Fault protection for DC Microgrid one of the challenges in the power system. All previous studies focus on protection due to the difficulty of linking DC and AC sources without designing a suitable protection system to operate this network in one network, and this network is called Microgrid (AC or DC). In this paper, a new DC Microgrid is designed. This Microgrid contains wind energy, Photovoltaic System (PV) with batteries, and the main grid (AC). Different types of fault analysis have been disused in this paper, like overcurrent protection, distance protection, and differential protection.

articleTitle: Wideband Measurement of High-Frequency Coupling Admittances for Single-Phase VSC Considering Grid Impedance
abstract: The wideband impedance measurement is a powerful tool to quickly grasp the input admittance characteristics of a voltage-source converter (VSC). However, the influence of frequency coupling characteristics needs to be carefully considered when the observation frequency is higher than half the VSC switching frequency. The frequency coupling features bring challenges to wideband-excitation-based measurement of VSC coupling admittances. In addition, the measured VSC coupling admittances are affected by the nonzero grid impedance, which means VSC coupling admittances cannot be obtained by the traditional impedance measurement method. This paper analyses the frequency distribution characteristics of high-frequency coupling admittances for a single-phase VSC. Then a decoupling test method for VSC coupling admittances by injecting a series of linearly independent excitation signals is proposed. It eliminates the influence of grid impedance on the measurement results of VSC coupling admittances. On this basis, in order to improve the test efficiency, a wideband measurement method based on the multi-tone signal is further proposed. The frequency of the wideband excitation signal is alternately distributed in odd and even numbers, which effectively avoids the influence of VSC frequency coupling phenomena. Hardware-in-the-loop simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed wideband measurement method.

articleTitle: EFFECTS OF AC SIDE FAULT ON DC SIDE FAULT CHARACTERISTICS IN FLEXIBLE DC DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM
abstract: Effect of AC side fault on DC side Fault Characteristics of Flexible DC Distribution System (FDCDS) was investigated with both theoretic analysis and simulation. Firstly, the relationship between DC side and AC measurement of flexible DC distribution network is introduced, and the DC voltage and current factors affecting DC side of converter are determined; secondly, the influence of symmetrical fault of AC power supply side on DC voltage and current is analyzed; secondly, the influence of asymmetric fault of AC power supply side on DC voltage and current is discussed, and the possible single-phase AC voltage and current are analyzed The influence of grounding fault, two-phase grounding fault and two-phase phase fault on DC voltage and current is analyzed. Finally, the research content is simulated by simulation, and the analysis method and conclusion can provide reference for the configuration of flexible DC distribution network protection scheme.

articleTitle: RESEARCH ON APPLICATION OF DC ELECTRIC SPRING IN DC DISTRIBUTION NETWORK
abstract: The DC distribution network is getting more and more attention in recent years. And the access of a high proportion of distributed renewable energy and DC loads has brought challenges to the operational stability of the DC system. Especially voltage stability is an important point that reflects the balance of supply and demand. In this paper, the application of DC electric springs in DC distribution networks is studied. DC electric springs are introduced to the non-critical load side, which can enhance the flexibility of loads. When the DC bus voltage fluctuates due to changes in the output of renewable energy or other factors, the DC spring on the non-critical load side is controlled to adjust the power on the non-critical load side to achieve the stability of the DC voltage, thereby ensuring the power demand of the important loads. This method has been verified in the DC distribution network model established in the Simulink. The results show that the application of DC electric spring in the DC distribution network helps to maintain the stability of the DC bus voltage and system operation, while enhancing the absorption of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Data-driven based modelling method of a PMSG
abstract: The traditional modelling method of permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) relies heavily on the internal parameters of the PMSG, dynamic of which is inconsistent with that of the actual PMSG if some parameters are unknown, resulting in errors in analysis results. In order to realize the dynamic fitting of the PMSG without known parameters, and improve the accuracy of the analysis results, a data-driven modelling method of the PMSG is proposed in this paper. Here in, the full-order dynamics of the PMSG is divided as multiple subsystems, so that the long short-term memory (LSTM) method can be used to quickly and accurately simulate the dynamics of each subsystem based on a large of measured data. Finally, a power system connected with a PMSG is as an example to demonstrate that the proposed method can fit dynamics of the PMSG accurately even if the parameters are unknow.

articleTitle: Resilient Control Strategy Based on Power Router for Distribution Network With Renewable Generation
abstract: In recent years, the blackouts of distribution networks due to extreme events have happened worldwide, which bring huge losses and seriously reduce the resilience. Efficient service restoration is an important measure to enhance distribution system resilience. Now a resilience enhancement control strategy is proposed for outages of important loads in traditional distribution network with failure. The strategy is based on power router (PR) in grid with RPG, considering the output of RPG, load response, working mechanism of PR. It realizes fast network reconfiguration and load balancing through real-time monitoring of load, power supply, switching state by edge agents and emergency cooperative control of cloud controller and PR. A hierarchical control is adopted for the MMC rectifier stage voltage outer loop, which generates inner loop command of arm current to realize steady operation and fault ride-through under complex working conditions, thus important loads won't be powered off after a fault. A typical network model is built for simulation. The results show that the strategy can effectively improve the resilience of the distribution system after failure.

articleTitle: COORDINATE CONTROL AND FAUTL RIDE THROUGH STRATEGIES FOR MULTI-TERMINAL DC GRID WITH OFFSHORE WIND FARM INTEGRATION BASED ON DIODE RECTIFIER
abstract: Offshore wind farm integrated by hybrid rectifier, which is composed of series connected diode rectifier (DR) and MMC, to onshore grid through hybrid multi-terminal direct current grid (MTDC), is investigated in this paper. As the instinct conduction characteristics of DR, whole HVDC system shows different fault characteristics. In this paper, coordinate control based on current droop for the hybrid MTDC is proposed. Fault characteristics of commutation failure is analyzed, and protection strategy is proposed. Simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the proposed control strategy during steady operation DC fault and under onshore and offshore fault conditions.

articleTitle: A DC line protection scheme based on transient energy ratio on both sides of current-limiting reactor
abstract: Due to the challenge brought by the widespread application of distributed power, grid planning is seeking to replace pure AC grid with AC/DC hybrid grid for its advantages in transmission capacity, power quality and economy. The short duration, fast rising speed and high peak value of the fault current of DC distribution network improve the requirements of its relay protection. Current-limiting reactors are widely used in DC line and can participate in the formation of protection schemes. Based on the study of the transient energy characteristics at both ends of the current-limiting reactor in the DC line, A DC line relay protection scheme and selection of faulted pole scheme based on transient energy ratio is proposed. By comprehensively utilizing the transient energy ratio of the current-limiting reactor on both positive electrode and negative electrode, a high-frequency permissible pilot protection of the DC line is formed to achieve fast, selective protection of DC line. The simulation results show that the protection scheme proposed in this paper can be used as a quick-action protection scheme for DC lines, and the influence of the transition resistance and the location of the fault point on the protection action characteristics is analysed in detail.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration method of distributed generation based on load transfer in distribution network
abstract: Due to distributed generation's (DG) its large number, there is no effective optimal configuration method in the early planning. In this paper, the optimal configuration of distributed generation is realized by using the electromagnetism-like mechanism(ELM) algorithm. The optimal configuration model of DG is established with the integration goal of network loss reduction and voltage stability. The coding method of DG location and capacity is proposed, and the optimization process is designed by using the electromagnetism-like mechanism algorithm. Simulation and optimization are carried out on IEEE-33 bus system to verify that the optimal loss is smaller and the minimum voltage is higher, and it has better global search ability when the control variable dimension of the optimization problem becomes more. This paper analyses the influence of the change of distribution network structure on the optimization results and the influence of different types of DG on the distribution network, and obtains the optimal configuration results of distributed generation with the optimal location and capacity.
